'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]]. [[Critical infrastructure]] is damaged in [[Kherson Oblast]] and a fire occurs at the [[Dnieper Hydroelectric Station]] in [[Zaporizhzhia]] causing around half a tonne of oil products to leak into the [[Dnieper]] river. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-russian-drones-damage-energy-infrastructure-south-2024-04-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/04/11/7450847/index.amp (Ukrainska Pravda)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
***[[Canada]] pledges $132.2 million dollars to [[Sudan]] to help people affected by the country's ongoing [[humanitarian crisis]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/10419904/canada-sudan-humanitarian-funding-anniversary/amp/ (Global News)]
*[[Alliance of Sahel States]]
**[[Nigerien crisis (2023–present)|Nigerien crisis]]
***Dozens of [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] instructors arrive in [[Niger]] as part of an agreement with the ruling [[National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland|military junta]] to a install state-of-the-art air defence system. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-68796359 (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] [[Hezbollah armed strength|forces]] launch dozens of rockets into [[Northern District (Israel)|northern Israel]]. The militant group says that the missile barrage targeted [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] [[artillery]] positions. No casualties are reported. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/04/12/hezbollah-says-fired-dozens-of-rockets-toward-israel- (Al Arabiya)]
*[[War in Amhara]]
**Two [[Fano (militia)|Fano]] militants are killed and a third is arrested during a [[shootout]] with [[Addis Ababa Federal Police|police]] near the [[Millennium Hall (Addis Ababa)|Millennium Hall]] in [[Addis Ababa]], [[Ethiopia]]. A civilian is also killed and two officers are wounded. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/04/12/ethiopia-fano-shootout-addis-adaba/283203da-f8d4-11ee-9506-c8544e5c9d86_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Egypt–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] pledges €1 billion in short-term financial aid to [[Egypt]] to help stabilise the country's economy. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eu-pledges-egypt-1-billion-euros-financial-aid-2024-04-12/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus]]
***It is reported that [[Israel]] is preparing for a direct retaliatory strike from [[Iran]] on southern or northern Israel as soon as the next 24 to 48 hours. A person briefed by the Iranian leadership says that while plans to strike are being discussed, no final decision has been made. [https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/iranian-attack-expected-on-israel-in-next-two-days-42b0537c (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***The [[United States]] restricts travel for [[Embassy of the United States, Jerusalem|its embassy]] personnel in Israel amid fears of a retaliation by Iran. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68795021 (BBC News)]
***The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] advises against all travel to Israel and the [[Palestinian territories]] due to the imminent possibility of an Iranian strike. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240412-uk-advises-against-travelling-to-israel/ (Middle East Monitor)]
***[[France]] advises its citizens against traveling to Iran, [[Lebanon]], Israel Palestine due to the risk of military escalation. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/04/12/politics/white-house-iran-threat-israel/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Germany]] tells its citizens to leave Iran immediately, saying that "air, land and sea transport routes" will likely be affected by military action in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/escalation-risk-germany-urges-its-citizens-leave-iran-2024-04-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Mali]]
**The [[National Committee for the Salvation of the People|military junta]] in [[Mali]] prohibits all forms of media from reporting on activities of political parties and associations. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2516448-militair-regime-mali-verbiedt-journalisten-verslag-te-doen-van-politiek (NOS)]
*[[Pakistan]] designates the [[Iran]]ian [[Quds Force]] [[Liwa Zainebiyoun]] as a [[terrorism in Pakistan|terrorist]] organization. [https://www.voanews.com/amp/pakistan-bans-iran-backed-shiite-group-fighting-in-syria-/7566593.html (VOA)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Russia]] successfully test-launches an [[intercontinental ballistic missile]] from the [[Kapustin Yar]] launch complex in [[Astrakhan Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-conducts-successful-intercontinental-ballistic-missile-test-2024-04-12/ (Reuters)]
